_comment: Household measures reviewed by hand and found wrong at their source. Keyed by food id; the servings listed replace every other source. Every entry says why.

oats-regular-and-quick-dry-a443fd._why: The legacy sample food oats-steel-cut-dry (1/4 cup = 42 g, right for dense steel-cut oats) was matched to rolled and quick oats, which weigh about 40 g per 1/2 cup (USDA).
